Our scouts have spotted battle droids at this abandoned station.|Onaconda Farr, to Kit Fisto|}} A '''skirmish''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After aiding in the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|escape]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] went into hiding from the Republic and established [[Robonino's hideout|headquarters]] on Rodia. Robonino set up an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Power generator/Legends|generator]] to power his modified [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and the surrounding wildlife soon began to suffer from the effects of the device. Rodia's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], requested a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to investigate the disturbances, and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] was sent in with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. While the [[Unidentified clone SCUBA commander|clone commander]] and his forces fought and defeated the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the base, Fisto found the underwater generator. Instead of capturing Robonino, Fisto was forced to destroy the generator and allow the bounty hunter to escape. Nevertheless, a [[Kwazel Maw/Legends|Kwazel Maw]] beast soon appeared and spat out the defeated Robonino right in front of the Republic forces, leading to the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary's]] arrest. ==Prelude== {{Quote|Whatever it is, it is killing all the wildlife in these waters.''"
"''Nature unbalanced is most perilous, Senator. Do not worry. I will get to the source of this dark current.|Onaconda Farr and Kit Fisto|}} [[File:RoboninosHideout-HuntingTheHuntersPartII.png|thumb|left|200px|Robonino's established headquarters]] In [[20 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] formed a team of hunters to free [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]—who had been [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|arrested]] for crimes against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]—from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The hunters' [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|mission]] was successful, and Bane and his team escaped with Ziro.{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}} Shortly thereafter, Bane transmitted the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|monetary reward]] for the mission into the accounts of his comrades and then ordered the bounty hunters to flee and hide from the Republic. One member of the team, the [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]], traveled to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] and established [[Robonino's hideout|headquarters]] at an abandoned station on the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. Robonino set up an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Power generator/Legends|generator]] to power his modified [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and wildlife in the area soon began to suffer from the generator's output. Fearing that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had returned to Rodia, the planet's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Senator/Legends|representative]], [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], requested a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to to investigate the disturbances on the planet. [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] arrived with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and after being directed toward the abandoned station by Farr, Fisto entered the water with several [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to find what was disrupting the planet's wildlife, while [[Unidentified clone SCUBA commander|his clone SCUBA commander]] remained on the surface to search the outpost. ==The skirmish== {{Quote|You did it, General. The droids are deactivated.''"
"''Yes, Commander. The waters also lie still, but I had to let the culprit behind all of this escape. For the sake of these currents, it's a trade I do not regret.|The clone SCUBA commander and Kit Fisto|}} Entering the abandoned station, the [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] ordered his forces to spread out, warning his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to be careful of battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that could be hiding in the station. A pair of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s noticed the intruders, and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were ambushed by B1 and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]], as well as [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], all hot-wired by Robonino from the remains of the droid deployment previously sent to Rodia by the Confederacy. The clones were able to cut their way through the base and defeat all of the droids. [[File:Kit_Robonino.png|thumb|right|250px|Robonino flees from Fisto.]] In the water, Fisto and his [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|clone SCUBA troopers]] found the droid generator, which promptly targeted two of the troopers with its [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] them. Fisto soon caught sight of a fleeing Robonino, and while opening fire with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], the bounty hunter launched several [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] toward the Jedi. Fisto was able to [[Telekinesis/Legends|redirect]] the explosives into the droid generator with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], destroying the device and disabling the battle droids, but his actions cost him the apprehension of Robonino. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Ah yes, look and see. Be good to your world, and it repays you in kind.|Kit Fisto, after a Kwazel Maw spits out Robonino|}} Fisto believed that he had made a willing trade in letting Robonino escape in exchange for eliminating the source of the wildlife disruptions. The Jedi Master reported to Farr that it had not been a Confederate outpost creating the disturbances, but rather that of a "skilled vandal" who had caused unintentional consequences on the Rodian wildlife. But then, a native [[Kwazel Maw/Legends|Kwazel Maw]] creature appeared out of the water and spat out Robonino right in front of Fisto, Farr, and the remaining clone troopers, enabling them to take Robonino into custody. ==Behind the scenes== The Rodia skirmish first appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part II)|''Hunting the Hunters (Part II)'']], an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the online [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]] that transitioned between the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first]] and [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second seasons]] of the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] and ''[[Swamp Station Sweep]]'', an online game released on [[StarWars.com]] that was based on the events of the comic, the game were somewhat inconsistent with one another. Specific continuity was not established between the comic and game, and it was also implied that Robonino was present both on land and underwater. This article assumes that Robonino was underwater per the events described in the webcomic. Although [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 28|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 28]] states that all of Fisto's clone troopers were killed upon finding Robonino's droid generator, that conflicts with the events of the webcomic, in which only two troopers were killed. This article assumes that the webcomic's version of events is correct. ==Appearances== *[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part II)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part II)]] {{1st}} *{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/swampstation|text=Swamp Station Sweep|int=Swamp Station Sweep}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars Magazine 1 (2014)|''Star Wars Magazine'' 1]] {{Imo}} *{{FactFile2014|28|FIS 1-6|Kit Fisto}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Rodia, skirmish on}} [[Category:Battles of Rodia]] [[Category:Events during the Clone Wars]]
